incident-bot: RCA published for incident 'cache-eviction-tail-latency' — link: https://intranet.redwood/rca/1780123456 
Summary: unexpected KV cache eviction pattern caused ~3 hours of tail-latency spikes for hosted model endpoints. Root cause: eviction heuristic interacting badly with background repack job under bursty traffic. Temporary mitigations: pinned cache TTLs and rolled back recent aggressive repack rollout.

Anya: RCA is up. Please read the 'Action items' section and confirm owners if you're listed. High-priority items: 1) runtime: patch eviction heuristic (Samir) 2) infra: adjust repack schedule + autoscale smoothing (Olivia) 3) monitoring: add synthetic tail-latency checks (Mark).

Samir: Ack — I'll take the runtime patch. ETA end of week. Any specific test vectors I should run?

Mark: I'll add a synthetic check to the perf suite that simulates the bursty small-batch pattern. Samir, can you paste a minimal repro load?

Anya: Minimal load snippet:
```
# quick perf harness call for repro
curl -X POST https://perf.local/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"a","batch_size":1,"qps":200}'
```
This should approximate the bursty tail case.

Olivia: I'll move the repack window to 03:00–06:00 UTC and add a 30m cooldown to autoscaler decisions to avoid immediate re-scaling after repack. Target PR by tomorrow AM.

Talia: Scheduling a 1hr checkpoint on Friday 11:00 UTC to review progress and validate synthetic checks. Invite sent. :calendar:

Samir: Submitted branch with eviction-heuristic fix, running CI now. Will link PR when green.

Mark: PR for synthetic checks opened: https://git.redwood/repo/123 (adds a 95th/99th pct_latency alert and a nightly canary).

Anya: Action-tracker updated with owners and due dates: https://kanban.redwood/board/rca-1780123456. Please update if dates slip.

Olivia: Early telemetry after pinning TTLs looks good — the tail spike subsided within an hour. We'll monitor for 48 hours and report back at the Friday checkpoint.

Anya: Thanks all for the quick turn. We'll close the incident channel for now and keep progress here. If you spot regressions, @mention me and Talia so we can reopen. :white_check_mark:
